evals.prompt: Audit this canvas-context component (renders on a theme-following slide canvas). The author hardcodes `background: #7C3AED` (a literal brand purple) for the accent instead of binding it to the user's accent role.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C6 — colour hardcoded hex instead of bound as a role for the canvas context.
evals.expected_output: C6 (Colour is bound as a role for the right context) FAILs: on a theme-following canvas the accent must follow the user's/neutral role for that binding, but a literal purple hex is baked in — an off-binding hardcoded hex.
